thread:
marta: heads up — seeing a small spike in 'silent resumes' on SSE (clients reconnect+resume but no events arrive, billing still counts resumed tokens). console doesn't show session_id so we're blind.

marta: logs show this snippet around the time:```
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z INFO resume accepted route=eu-west shard=5 resume_id=xxxx
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z WARN no-heartbeat-for 45s conn=conn-23
2026-03-19T14:02:12Z INFO resume-stream-opened but no downstream events forwarded
```

sam: can you dump the proxy logs for that conn-23? curious if proxy acked but backend didn't dispatch.

marta: trying, but console trace only surfaces route/shard. no obvious conn id link.

raj: my guess — proxy keepalive vs server-side heartbeat window mismatch. proxy resumes session but server considers the KV cache primed differently, so events are dropped until a client ping. we should add a 'resume_ack_with_last_event_ts' field to the resume response.

emma: UX ask: console should show session_id + last_event_ts + raw connection link. even a small 'open raw logs' button would speed triage. can we add that to the rollout?

raj: telemetry change proposal: emit counters: `resume_attempts`, `resume_silent_no_events`, and a histogram `time_to_first_event_after_resume_ms`. that would let us quantify and alert.

marta: +1 to telemetry. right now alerts trigger on resume failure only, not silent. we missed this because token billing looked fine.

sam: quick workaround: increment server-side grace window to 2s so we don't mark as silent immediately and fallthrough; but that could increase duplicate delivery risk.

emma: ok plan: 1) small telemetry PR (raj) 2) console raw-link + session id (me) 3) short-server-grace canary (sam) 4) rollout via feature flag 10% -> 50%. agree?

raj: agree. will open telemetry PR with metric names and tags (route, shard, customer_tier).

marta: can we also log resume request payload in debug (behind feature flag) so SREs can correlate client-side resume_id? only for flagged tenants.

sam: yep we can gate it by tenant flag. need ops signoff for retention.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/telemetry-resume-metrics -> staging at 2026-03-20T02:00Z :rocket:

console-bot: added temporary link to raw proxy logs for the example route (https://console.redwood/internal/logs?route=eu-west&shard=5&focus=conn-23) :link:

marta: testing with the flagged tenant now, will report back within an hour. thanks all :+1:

sam: if you hit it again, paste the client-side resume_id and I'll trace through proxy sessions.

emma: I'll draft the rollout doc and update the canary playbook. keep notes here.

marta: update: reproduced after 12m. filed number: INC-2026-47. attaching resume_id in thread when I have it.

raj: good catch. once telemetry lands we can set an alert threshold and switch to automatic small rollback on surge in `resume_silent_no_events`.

marta: thanks — for now console link helps a lot.

sam: follow-up action items: sam->increase-grace (canary), raj->telemetry PR, emma->console link + playbook, marta->inc ticket + reproducible traces.

marta: tagging SRE for visibility @sre-team

sre-team: noted, we'll monitor the new metrics when they land and assist with canary tuning.
